description: This Dart source file defines the AuthProvider class for managing authentication state in a Flutter application. It handles loading sessions, login, logout, token persistence, and integration with real-time services. The class interacts with APIs and local storage, providing authentication-related functionality and exposing relevant data to other parts of the app.

classes.name: AuthProvider
classes.description: Manages authentication state, token persistence, and real-time service connection. Offers methods for session loading, login, and logout, and maintains user info and token.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: Factory constructor initializing the AuthProvider with API and real-time services.

methods.name: loadSession
methods.description: Loads an existing user session from local storage, updating user and token info, and connecting to real-time service as needed.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs user login using supplied credentials or mock logic if in mock mode. Handles token extraction, user info retrieval, and real-time connection.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears stored tokens, resets user info, and disconnects from real-time service.
